build_PatchEmbed: build a PatchEmbed module to convert image tensors to patch embeddings with configurable kernel size and stride
build_PatchMerging: build a PatchMerging layer to downsample patch feature maps using nn.Unfold with adaptive padding
build_ConditionalAttention: build a ConditionalAttention module for self or cross attention with separate query key positional projections
build_DynamicConv: build a DynamicConv module that generates per-sample convolution parameters using learned linear projections
use_coordinate_to_encoding: use coordinate_to_encoding to convert coordinate tensors into sinusoidal positional embeddings for transformer models
